content.title: Safety and Security in your Place of Worship
content.summary: Places of worship are increasingly recognized as potential targets for violence, prompting the need for preventative measures and preparedness. A course is offered to help congregations enhance safety, including a security walkthrough by an officer who will provide tailored recommendations. For further assistance or to arrange a walkthrough, individuals can contact 720-898-6883.
content.body:
Often in the past, places of worship were not considered potential targets for violence. Unfortunately, due to recent tragic events across the world, we now know that places of worship, schools, public buildings, and other public areas are susceptible to violence. It is essential to take preventative steps now to help lessen the chance for violence and to ensure a better response to violence if it happens. This course covers:

- Preventing violence at your religious sanctuary.
- What you can do to prepare.
- Things to consider when your place of worship is in session.

An officer will visit your place of worship to meet with staff and conduct a security walkthrough, providing recommendations to enhance safety and reduce vulnerabilities for crime.

For more information or to request an officer to meet with you and walk through your place of worship, please call 720-898-6883.
